title: dust and bone
description: a mod that adds some new things (e.g. more tools and weapons) see description for more detail
body:
this is a mod that I made while I was bored
(very simple)
it adds two new biomes:
bone desert - a sparse desert made of bone dust, very little trees will spawn here
stony peaks - basically just the overworld but there is stone rather than grass (good for those who are to scared to go caving)

4 new tools (so far):
emerald hammer - a hammer made of emerald with high efficiancy
raw blade - a dagger made of raw iron
raw scimitar - a scimitar (curved blade) made of raw iron
steel greatsword - a large sword made using the advanced crafting table (5x5 crafting table)

and a few items:
iron shard - a shard of raw iron
diamond coin - a diamond coin
gold coin - a gold coin
pure gold
liquid gold

i made it with the help of my good old friend AI, and also some pure brainpower.
this is my first ever mod so don't judge me!
thanks for playing (if you do)
